2. Relevant Regulatory Basis: Source 1 - Chunk 183B from [Revised-Guidance-Note-7A–Implementation of various aspects of the FIC Act]

Explanation: The regulatory context emphasizes that accountable institutions must conduct an entity wide AML/CFT/CFP risk assessment and determine controls required to mitigate identified risks, which form part of RMCP (Revised-Guidance-Note-7A–Implementation of various aspects of the FIC Act - Chunk 183B). The board must review this plan before approval.
